purpose: Both artifact trees are excluded from ordinary git collection, so publishing them means stating every file's byte size and sha256. Every number any record document quotes about an artifact or a log traces to an entry here. The two trees published per-file are `raw/` and `logs/`: every entry below was measured from this checkout's disk when this manifest was written, so an entry naming a file that is not present cannot occur. A staging tree recorded by an artifact in `logs/` but not present in this checkout is CITED to that artifact rather than restated per file, because a value restated in two places is two measurements that can disagree rather than one measurement cited twice.

regenerated.why: Re-measured from this checkout's disk after the QA-driven corrections of this checkpoint. harness/lib/normalize/cli.py gained a named halt for an unexpected direct child of harness/artifacts/raw/ and the --repo-root owner-root declaration, and the normalizer was re-run over the unchanged canonical inputs so its run record describes the code that is committed. The adapter-test corpus gained the fixture-provenance corrections and the RecordedFixtureMetadataTest contracts, and the suite was re-measured over the combined corpus. The log tree took the evidence of the remaining corrections: the twelve re-executed Opengrep taint arms, the importCpg load of the narrowed witness graph recorded as cpg-verify.log PART 2, the third flatgraph ceiling arm at 8 GiB, the live census of /opt/blitzy-harness/cpg-input, corrections of record in runner-metadata.json, cpg-frontend.log, cpg-graph-record.log, cpg-module-coverage.json, cpg-frontend-input-manifest.json, cpg-identity.txt, cpg-shims-collision-measurement.log, build-reactor.log and gate-record.json, and the fourteen reverification-f1 through f5 evidence files that publish the disposition of the five re-executed blocking findings. Re-measured AGAIN on 2026-09-02T19:41:00Z, after a further QA-driven checkpoint moved four log members: harness/ENVIRONMENT.md was re-anchored to the graph's write-time record of account, which rewrote cpg-identity.txt (6,591 -> 9,123 B) and recorded the correction beside the observations it supersedes in gate-record.json (92,364 -> 100,747 B), runner-metadata.json (189,356 -> 199,061 B) and reverification-f2-graph-identity.txt (22,308 -> 31,447 B). No member was added, removed or renamed, so file_count is unchanged at 151 and logs.total_bytes moved by exactly +29,759 B to 144,068,455. The normalizer was then re-run canonically over the unchanged raw tree so its run record describes the runner-metadata now committed rather than the superseded digest it had read, moving normalize-run.json (763,882 -> 764,476 B) and findings-publication.json (2,985 -> 3,003 B) and bringing logs.total_bytes to 144,069,067; that run reproduced oss-scan-results/findings.json and findings.csv BYTE-IDENTICALLY, so the dataset is unchanged. harness/artifacts/raw/ was not touched at all: 8 members, 120,538,389 B, every digest unchanged - the dataset and every count derived from it are unaffected. Every entry below is a measurement of the file as it is on disk now; the tree and this manifest agree member for member. A further re-measurement follows the security checkpoint's own additions to this tree: twelve files were added to harness/artifacts/logs/ by the resolution of the security testing findings SEC-01 to SEC-10 -- eight sec-gate-* files recording the fail-closed pre-scan gates and their negative cases, and four reverification-sec-* files recording the diagnostic-secrecy re-verification, the malformed percent-escape re-verification and the toolchain advisory register with its publisher sources -- and harness/artifacts/logs/adapter-tests-run.json was re-measured because the suite grew over a corpus of 106 fixtures. The previous edition's 383,486-byte figure for adapter-tests-run.json, which disagreed with the bytes on disk while its digest matched, is corrected by that re-read rather than carried forward. file_count therefore moves from 151 to 163 and logs.total_bytes to the figure stated below, measured over the tree carrying BOTH the graph-identity/heap corrections and the security gates: neither of the two figures published while those two sets of corrections were measured separately describes this tree, so both were discarded and the tree re-measured member by member. harness/artifacts/raw/ is still untouched: 8 members, 120,538,389 B, every digest unchanged. FINAL re-measurement, over the tree that carries both sets of corrections together: the graph-identity gate was re-run and, because the environment record now describes the graph on disk while the gate also reads that record, it PASSES -- so joern-preflight.log, which is the gate's own output and is replaced by any default-form run, moved from 5,074 B (a VERDICT: HALT taken while the record was still stale) to 3,213 B (VERDICT: PASS). The normalizer was then re-run canonically once more, because its run record had been written before the diagnostic-secrecy and percent-escape changes landed in shape.py and paths.py and so described a producer that no longer existed: normalize-run.json moved 764,476 -> 767,834 B (it now carries the current vocabularies) and findings-publication.json 3,003 -> 2,985 B. That run reproduced oss-scan-results/findings.json and findings.csv BYTE-IDENTICALLY at 9,430 rows with the identity 10,016 = 9,430 + 586, so the dataset is unchanged by either set of corrections. No member was added, removed or renamed: file_count stays 163 and logs.total_bytes is 144,246,813.
